chk_farms_location_valid.name: chk_farms_location_valid
chk_farms_location_valid.value: "farms"."location" IS NULL OR (NOT ST_IsEmpty("farms"."location") AND ST_X("farms"."location") BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND ST_Y("farms"."location") BETWEEN -90 AND 90)

chk_fields_location_valid.name: chk_fields_location_valid
chk_fields_location_valid.value: "fields"."location" IS NULL OR (NOT ST_IsEmpty("fields"."location") AND ST_X("fields"."location") BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND ST_Y("fields"."location") BETWEEN -90 AND 90)

chk_fields_boundary_valid.name: chk_fields_boundary_valid
chk_fields_boundary_valid.value: "fields"."boundary" IS NULL OR (ST_IsValid("fields"."boundary") AND NOT ST_IsEmpty("fields"."boundary"))
